vulnerabilities.title: Potential for Implementation Reset to Zero Bypassing Governance
vulnerabilities.description: If the default implementation is compromised or not properly vetted, the Agent contract could behave maliciously.

vulnerabilities.title: Missing Validation for Zero Address in Allowed Implementations
vulnerabilities.description: Confusion in the intended behavior; if the zero address is allowed, the function does not revert, but the effect is the same as the reset. This could be a logic error in the factory's configuration.
